subject: [PATCH v3 1/3] fs: stamp the current time for a stale delegated ctime update

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the way delegated ctime updates are handled for NFS clients. When a client moves the timestamp backwards on purpose, as utimensat() does, the current time is stamped instead of skipping the update. This ensures that the delegated change remains visible in the ctime. The patch modifies the inode_set_ctime_deleg function to compare the updated timestamp with the existing one after clamping and truncating it, and if they are equal or the update is older, it returns the current time. This prevents a race condition where concurrent updates to the inode can cause the update to be skipped.
